summaryEn:

analysis: 歸藏这条不是在夸一张图，而是在记录 Codex 开始主动拆任务：发现逐张生成素材低效，就转向自己寻找可用资产。对关注 AI、图像和设计工具的他来说，这个细节比成品更重要，因为它说明编码 agent 正在从“按指令执行”走向“会优化工作流”。真正的门槛也随之变成判断力和资源调用，而不只是会写代码。

analysis: 歸藏给 Codex 一个“中国风杀戮尖塔”的粗略目标，结果它连代码和素材都自己凑出可玩的版本。这里的看点不是游戏有多完整，而是从一句需求到可体验原型的路径被压短了。对内容创作者和独立开发者来说，agent 的价值正在从“帮我补代码”变成“帮我把想法先跑起来”。

name: Hwang

summary: 人和 AI 是一样的，工具集太复杂，就会不知道选啥。大家都喜欢简单清晰的工具。
summaryEn: 人和 AI 是一样的，工具集太复杂，就会不知道选啥。大家都喜欢简单清晰的工具。
analysis: Hwang 做设计和工具产品，提到“人和 AI 都会被复杂工具集搞懵”，其实是在讲 agent 产品的一个硬问题：能力越多，选择成本越高。给模型塞一堆工具并不等于更聪明，真正好用的是把可选动作收敛到清晰、少数、可预期。这个判断对 AI 工具设计很实用。

name: Hwang
role: Design/Vibe/Shape macOS ► http://harness.today iOS ► http://handstime.app / http://lofidot.com / http://slabox.app early http://bridge.surf @AFFiNEOfficial
summary: 欧冠两天的比赛，展示了足球世界的多样性...
summaryEn: 欧冠两天的比赛，展示了足球世界的多样性...
analysis: 这条欧冠感想看似离 AI 很远，但放在 Hwang 一贯的设计视角里，重点是“多样性”本身：不同风格、节奏和策略同时成立。做产品也一样，尤其是 AI 工具，未必只有一种正确形态。能不能给不同用户留出自己的节奏，往往比追一个统一范式更重要。

name: Aaron Levie
role: ceo @box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
summary:
Radiologist growth is a perfect example of what happens when automation comes into supply-constrained professions. We have more radiologists, getting paid more, when even more technology is available, than ever.
We myopically think that demand for a skill is static and
"A decade ago, AI was supposed to replace radiologists. Today, radiologists make more than $500,000 per year, and their employment continues to grow, see chart below. Reading scans is a task, not a job, and when the task gets cheaper, demand for the job grows."
summaryEn:
Radiologist growth is a perfect example of what happens when automation comes into supply-constrained professions. We have more radiologists, getting paid more, when even more technology is available, than ever.
We myopically think that demand for a skill is static and
"A decade ago, AI was supposed to replace radiologists. Today, radiologists make more than $500,000 per year, and their employment continues to grow, see chart below. Reading scans is a task, not a job, and when the task gets cheaper, demand for the job grows."
analysis: Aaron Levie 用放射科医生举例，反驳“自动化一定替代职业”的直线叙事：读片只是任务，任务成本下降后，医疗影像需求反而可能扩大。Box 做企业内容管理，他关心的是 AI 进入专业场景后的需求弹性。这里的启发是，AI 先改变工作的吞吐量，再重新分配人的价值。

name: Garry Tan
role: President & CEO @ycombinator —Founder @garryslist —Creator of GStack & GBrain—designer/engineer who helps founders—SF Dem accelerating the boom loop
summary: It is much better if you use GBrain for retrieval
summaryEn: It is much better if you use GBrain for retrieval
analysis: Garry Tan 直接说检索应该用 GBrain，像是给创业者和开发者递了一个很具体的工具偏好。作为 YC CEO，他的信号意义在于：AI 应用的胜负越来越依赖检索质量，而不是只看模型本体。谁能把私有知识、上下文和回答稳定接起来，谁就更接近真实生产力。

name: Garry Tan
role: President & CEO @ycombinator —Founder @garryslist —Creator of GStack & GBrain—designer/engineer who helps founders—SF Dem accelerating the boom loop
summary:
Almost any decision in business and life can be decided by:
1/ Are we lucky? Great.
2/ Otherwise what is the smart gritty thing to do?
Lucky things happen to lucky people. But after that most of the manifold of outcomes requires true grit and smarts.
summaryEn:
Almost any decision in business and life can be decided by:
1/ Are we lucky? Great.
2/ Otherwise what is the smart gritty thing to do?
Lucky things happen to lucky people. But after that most of the manifold of outcomes requires true grit and smarts.
analysis: Garry Tan 把决策拆成两步：有运气就接住，没有运气就做聪明又坚韧的事。这不是鸡汤式创业箴言，而是 YC 语境里很实际的 founder 操作系统。AI 热潮里偶然红利很多，但最后能留下的团队，还是要靠连续的小判断和硬执行把概率磨高。

name: OpenAI
role: OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. We’re hiring: http://openai.com/jobs
summary:
Goblin and related magical mentions were overrewarded in training, and the behavior was reinforced over successive models.
We removed the goblin-affine reward signal for future models, and filtered training data where creatures appeared in irrelevant contexts.
summaryEn:
Goblin and related magical mentions were overrewarded in training, and the behavior was reinforced over successive models.
We removed the goblin-affine reward signal for future models, and filtered training data where creatures appeared in irrelevant contexts.
analysis: OpenAI 这条用玩笑口吻解释训练奖励里某类奇幻提及被过度强化，并说已经移除相关奖励信号。表面是一次社区梗的收尾，实质是在提醒大家：模型气质也来自训练数据和奖励设计。越强的模型越需要更细的行为校准，否则一点偏好就会被连续版本放大。

name: OpenAI
role: OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. We’re hiring: http://openai.com/jobs
summary:
The goblin era may be over, but you can still unleash the creatures in Codex.
Happy trolling.
summaryEn:
The goblin era may be over, but you can still unleash the creatures in Codex.
Happy trolling.
analysis: OpenAI 紧接着把这个梗转到 Codex，语气很轻，但产品信号很明确：编码 agent 已经成了他们对外沟通的重要载体。热评也基本顺着玩笑延展，说明社区已经把 Codex 当成一个有性格的工具来讨论。对开发者生态来说，这种“可玩性”会降低尝试门槛。

name: Peter Yang
role: Practical AI tutorials and interviews for busy people | Join 140K+ readers at http://creatoreconomy.so | Product at Roblox
summary: Well we had a good run of almost a year being healthy but my kid has made me sick again
summaryEn: Well we had a good run of almost a year being healthy but my kid has made me sick again
analysis: Peter Yang 这条只是说孩子又把自己传染病了，和 AI 没直接关系，但它让这批 builder 动态有一点生活纹理。作为长期写实用 AI 教程的人，他的日常提醒我们：工具再自动化，创作者和产品人的节奏仍然被家庭、健康和精力限制着。生产力讨论不能完全脱离人的现实。

name: Peter Yang
role: Practical AI tutorials and interviews for busy people | Join 140K+ readers at http://creatoreconomy.so | Product at Roblox
analysis: Peter Yang 问 OpenClaw 是否已经支持低延迟实时通话，问题很具体，也很像产品人会问的门槛指标。AI 硬件或桌面助手如果要进入真实互动，延迟比“能不能回答”更决定体验。对 OpenClaw 这类 agentic 产品来说，实时语音可能是从玩具走向陪伴式工具的关键一步。

name: Orange AI
role: CEO of MarsWave @ColaOSOfficial
summary:

权益是 SaaS 时代的产物
打算把我做的所有产品的订阅方案取消，已经付款订阅的用户我会返还对应的消费额度，以后我的所有 vibe 产品都不设置 pro 等各种等级方案，所有功能免费对所有用户开放，只保留一种盈利方式：按需付费。我将在这周开始优先改造 tuwa ai 以适配新的费用计划。

name: 今日总结
role: Builder Daily
summary: 今天的主线很清楚：agent 正从演示品进入基础设施和工作流。Codex 被用来做游戏、审查提交、筛选活动回复，Cursor SDK 和 Cloudflare 则把 agent 接进邮件、CI、部署和账号体系；另一边，Replit、OpenClaw、按需付费和教育折扣都在回答同一个问题：能力落地后，谁来使用、怎么收费、怎样稳定运行。AI 热度还在，但今天更像是在补商业化和工程化这两块地基。
